Transparency & Timeline Notice

Engine Room Records is a multimedia storytelling and world-building project. The music is generated using a commercial Suno license, with conceptual lore, characters, and lyrics co-written by human direction and Gemini.

Dual Timelines: To maintain our immersive fictional universe while strictly complying with modern digital distribution standards, our catalog features two timelines: a fictional Narrative Era (e.g., 1987) tied to the band's lore, and a real-world Actual Release Date (e.g., 2026) reflecting when the audio was officially distributed to streaming platforms. A Closed Collective

Engine Room Records is a private, self-publishing imprint created by Michael P. Ragsdale to manage his generative AI music portfolio. We do not sign outside artists and we do not accept unsolicited demos or submissions. Any unsolicited media sent to our servers is automatically and permanently deleted unread.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
